## R Packages
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE)
library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(knitr)
```

```{r rpkgs}
urls <-c("https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=antitrust","https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=trade","https://CRAN.R-project.org/package=competitiontoolbox") 

mypkgs <- pkgsearch::ps("Taragin",size = 100) %>%
  filter(purrr::map_lgl(package_data, ~ grepl("Charles Taragin", .x$Author, fixed = TRUE))) %>%
  mutate(package_order = factor(package, levels = c("antitrust", "trade", "competitiontoolbox"))) %>%
  arrange(package_order) %>% select(package,title,description) %>% mutate(package=paste0("[",package,"]","(",urls,")"), `public instance`=c("","","https://daag.shinyapps.io/ct_shiny/")) %>% mutate(description=gsub("\\s+"," ",description))

kable(mypkgs)

```
